A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same PTDI research work. Their main text, figures, tables, equations, and Appendices A–G are readable and support comparison, including material relocated between versions.

before.justification: v2 reports original LLM/VLM identification experiments measuring FIR and power, plus JKBB bias and MSE results in Appendix F.

after.justification: v3 reports original LLM/VLM identification experiments and estimator evaluations in Section 4 and Appendix F, retaining and revising results from v2.

M1.justification: Appendix C.4, Equation (42), changes the specified bandwidth coefficient from c_hat(c_hat−1)^2 to c_hat^2(c_hat−1), which feeds the bandwidth calculation in Equation (38). This is a limited procedural correction; Algorithm 1, the main-text kernel, conformal scaling/BH procedure, and adjusted-moment extension otherwise remain unchanged.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate WikiMIA, ArXivTection, XSum, BBC Real Time, VL-MIA/Flickr, and VL-MIA/DALL-E under the same task coverage. The power-chart caption changes from WikiMIA to BBC, matching the BBC experiment already described in v2 Section 4.2; this does not establish new coverage.

E2.justification: The corresponding comparisons retain KTD and the same selection-procedure comparators: Vanilla BH, Storey-BH, BKY, and Quantile-BH. Newly cited related work is not added to the evaluated comparator sets.

E3.justification: Section 4 and Appendix E retain the evaluated models and scores, FIR/power metrics, random half-splits, Table 3 sample counts, and VLM generation length of 32 tokens. No evaluation-design change is reported separately from the method's bandwidth correction.

E4.justification: The existing selection-procedure ablation in Table 1 receives revised PTDI power measurements, updating evidence about the benefit of JKBB scaling. No new ablation question is introduced; the membership-proportion, calibration-size, adjusted-moment, and estimator-accuracy analyses are retained.

E5.justification: v3 adds standard errors throughout Table 1 and 95% confidence intervals to the power comparison, formerly Figure 3 and now Figure 2. Both versions already report 1,000 repetitions in Appendix E and standard-deviation shading in Figure 5; an increase in runs is not established.

E6.justification: Table 1 revises 26 of 27 PTDI power entries slightly: for example, NeoX-20B with MIN-K% at alpha=0.1 changes from 6.05% to 5.90%. Comparator means and rankings remain unchanged. The KTD power-chart estimates also shift slightly, while the other plotted results and Appendix F results are retained.

T1.justification: Appendix C.1 revises the kernel in Equations (22)–(23) to match main-text Equation (11), and changes the second-order bias coefficient from f'(1)+f''(1) to 2f'(1)+f''(1). Equation (42) is also corrected. These are local derivation revisions, with unchanged principal theorems and proofs; the retained kernel-moment formulas and Equation (41) remain inconsistent with the corrections.

C1.justification: The central claims remain set-level training-data identification with FIR control, improved power through JKBB scaling, and an adjusted-moment extension using known members. Although one introductory sentence about the extension is removed, contribution 3, Section 5, and the conclusion retain it.

C2.justification: The interpretations of scaling, known-member calibration, and calibration-size effects are retained. Both conclusions state the limitation requiring distributionally similar unseen calibration data and suggest weighted conformal p-values for future distribution-shift handling.

D1.justification: v3 adds an implementation-code repository link in the abstract, absent from v2. Appendix C.4 also revises the explicit coefficient needed to reproduce bandwidth selection. The remaining experimental implementation disclosures are substantially unchanged.

R1.justification: A new conformal-inference discussion distinguishes prediction sets from conformal selection and explicitly positions PTDI within the latter. It adds relevant references, including Bai et al. (2025), Jin and Candès (2026), and Hao et al. (2026), alongside additional contamination/MIA citations. Earlier positioning is largely retained.

P1.justification: v3 inserts main-text Section 6, Related Work, reusing Appendix A material and adding the conformal-inference discussion; Appendix A becomes Additional Related Work. Other edits include acknowledgements, publication information, and limited introductory wording changes. Most exposition remains unchanged.

P2.justification: Table 1 is reformatted for means and standard errors. The power chart gains error bars and a corrected BBC caption, while the FIR and power comparisons exchange figure numbers. Several displays move with the revised layout, but the same seven figures and four tables remain.

improvement.justification: v3 improves assessment of the existing evidence through standard errors, confidence intervals, a corrected dataset caption, and implementation-access information. The added conformal context and partial reconciliation of the JKBB derivation also help. However, inconsistent kernel-moment formulas and Equation (41) remain, limiting the mathematical improvement. These are useful but bounded gains, with essentially unchanged experimental coverage and conclusions.
